rows.en:
(Today I'll stop fighting it and show
some real enthusiasm!)

No, not that long.
Now, let's get right to the training, please!
rows.notes: Both genders; answers Hilda's 'sorry to keep you waiting'.

rows.en:
Oh, you're all fired up today.
All right, we start with stretches. Let's go!
Yes! I'm counting on you!
rows.notes: x4: player to Hilda here, and Ranka to the player in frd_rnk_103 (asking the player to model again); 'I'm counting on you' fits both, speaker asks the listener.

rows.en:
Good, that was some fine training today.
Keep the same attitude from now on, got it?
(Phew, I'm tired, but it feels kinda good!)

(Today I'll stop fighting it and show
some real enthusiasm!)
(Haah, I'm tired, but it feels kinda good!)

(Well, guess it's the usual training today too...
Not that that's a bad thing...)
Hey, \p, you're late!

Ah, Hilda-sensei, I'm sorry!
I was just thinking about something and...

What, something bothering you?
A troubled mind leads to a tired body.
Want to skip today?
No, I'm fine. Let's train, please!

I see. Then let's begin.
Whatever you do, don't overdo it.

Good, that's a proper answer!
Then we start with stretches, as usual.

Yes!
And... hup!

Oh, looking good. Your body's really shaping up.
Don't overdo it. The basic rule is 'Hurts-Good'!
rows.notes: Hilda. 'Itakimo' is her coined stretching rule (itai + kimochii), first explained in slice 75 (c05598/c05599); rendered 'hurts so good' here, must match slice 75's rendering. Aligned with slice 75 ('Hurts-Good').

rows.en:
All right, that should be enough.
Overdoing your stretches isn't good either.

Now, let's see... Today we'll just take it easy.
Running, five laps of the schoolyard!
Huh? Five laps? Not fifty?

Sometimes you need to rest your body too.
Just do as I say!
(Hmm, I wonder what's up with Sensei today...)
rows.notes: Male only; subject (Hilda) restored from context.

rows.en: I finished my run!

I see. Then let's stop here for today.
Do a light cool-down, then head home.

Huh? We're done already?
What's going on today?

Well, pushing yourself too hard isn't good either.
You've got classes too, so keep your
self-training in moderation.
Huh... But...
Hm? You have a problem with that?
No! Not at all!
(Hmm, I wonder what's up with Hilda-sensei...)
(Well, it's probably the usual training today too...)

Ah, Hilda-sensei, I'm sorry!
I was just thinking about something...

Yes!
And... heave-ho!
Huh? Only five laps? Not fifty?
(Huh? I wonder what's gotten into Sensei today...)
rows.notes: Female only; subject (Hilda) restored from context.

rows.en:
Huh? We're done already?
I thought we were just getting started...
(I wonder what's up with Hilda-sensei today?)
(All right, I'm gonna give training my all today too!)
Not at all. Thanks for coaching me again today!
rows.notes: Both genders; answers Hilda's 'sorry to keep you waiting'.

rows.en:
Mm...
Let's see. Today we'll take it easy again.
Huh? Oh... okay...
rows.notes: x4, player, frd_hld_004/005; follows c05351's 'Huh? Oh, okay...'.

rows.en: Your answer's too sluggish!
All right, that should do for today.
Huh? I can still keep going!
Are you refusing to listen to me?
No, sorry! Thank you very much!
(Maybe Hilda-sensei is looking out for me...)
(All right, I'm gonna give training my all today too!)
Huh? I'm still good to go!
(Maybe Hilda-sensei is looking out for me...)

(All right, time to fire myself up and work hard
today too... Oh, there's Hilda-sensei.)

No, I just got here...
Huh? Hilda-sensei, you're not in your tracksuit today...
No training today. We're going to unwind.

Oh, really? So that's why you're in regular clothes today.
Then maybe I'll just head home today...

What are you talking about? I said we're unwinding.
Hurry up and get changed. We're going out!
Huh? Oh, okay.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Sensei.
Mm. Then let's start with some tea.
Order whatever you like. My treat.

Okay, thank you!
Then, um, an iced coffee and a cheesecake...

Are you an idiot?!
Why load up on stimulants and fat to unwind?!
I keep telling you to look after your health every day!
Well, um, you said 'whatever I like'...

Never mind. Take your time choosing.
I'll have the low-fat hippo-cow milk
and a bagel sandwich.
Oh, then I'll have the same.
Good, that's the right attitude.

By the way, Sensei, why is training off today,
and why are we 'unwinding' instead?

Mm. You seemed to be pushing a bit too hard lately,
so I figured I'd better teach you to rest too.

Oh, is that what it was? I'm sorry.
But you don't need to worry about me that much.

Looking out for my students is my job. Don't mind it.
More importantly, don't take your health lightly.
If you slip up, it could cost you your life.
Huh? Um... my life...?

Well, it's just an example.
If you're not in top shape when you hit a crisis,
it'll be hard to get out of it. That's all.
(That's kind of an extreme example...)
Hm? Something wrong?

Let's continue.
So, you rest body and mind like this to prepare
for the next training. That's the point.

You especially have been working very hard lately.
Overworking your body isn't good either.
Keep taking proper breaks from now on.

Besides, kids your age should be itching to have fun.
Don't you even have a girlfriend?
rows.notes: Hilda, male version only (female version says boyfriend, c05796).

rows.en:
Well, sadly, there's no one I could really call
a girlfriend...

What, how pathetic.
That's no good for a student of mine.
I'm really sorry...

All right, it's settled. From now on, whenever
you want to unwind, feel free to invite me.

uncertain: c05717: Hilda's coined stretching rule 'Itakimo' (itai + kimochii, 'painful but pleasant') rendered 'hurts so good'; it is introduced in slice 75 (c05598/c05599, c05604, c05618), so the term should be aligned with whatever slice 75 uses.
c05704: shared by the player (to Hilda) and Ranka (to the player, frd_rnk_103); 'Yes! I'm counting on you!' keeps the direction (speaker asks listener) for both.
